description: Structured output schema for Codex test-run reports. Used with codex exec --output-schema.

status.description: COMPLETE: every run in the brief executed (pass or fail). PARTIAL: some runs executed. BLOCKED: nothing could run.

summary.description: What ran and headline pass/fail counts, written for the reviewer.

runs.description: One entry per numbered run in the brief, in order.

log_file.description: Absolute path of the tee'd full log file.

log_ref.description: Log file plus line range, e.g. logs/01-unit.log:1042-1088.

repro.description: Minimal command to reproduce just this failure.

anomalies.description: Every console error, unexpected warning, or off-script observation across ALL runs, enumerated VERBATIM — even when target assertions passed. Never classify anything as expected, noise, or pre-existing; that classification belongs to the reviewer. Empty only if genuinely nothing unexpected was observed.

log_ref.description: Log file plus line range where it appears, e.g. logs/04-forms.log:25.

occurrences.description: Which runs/pages it appeared on and roughly how often.

environment_notes.description: Runtime versions, required env vars, skipped suites, setup quirks. NOT for errors/warnings — those go in anomalies.
